rachats.citation: In September 2017, the company announced the acquisition of Cary, North Carolina-headquartered chip simulation firm Coventor.
In November 2022, it was announced Lam had acquired the Salzburg-headquartered, wet processing semiconductor equipment provider, Semsysco GmbH.
That same month, Lam also acquired the Texas-based plasma simulation company, Esgee Technologies, Inc.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
